_meta.note: The same adapter+host driven through one shell-command turn on the ALLOW path: the client answers session/request_permission with allow_once, so tool_call_update reaches completed. Covers agent_message_chunk, usage_update, tool_call, session/request_permission (options allow_once / abort(reject_once) -- this host offers TWO kinds, not goose's four), tool_call_update in_progress then completed carrying the command's real output, and the session/prompt result with stopReason. One session_info_update is kept to show the adapter's muse/hostCompatibility _meta (SDK/host fingerprints). Reductions: session id -> muse-session-1, permission id -> perm-1, every turn/item/approval uuid and tool-call id -> fixed synthetic values (muse-id-N / muse-call-N); home/scratch paths -> ~; the 30+ frames of this turn reduced to the required-class carriers. The ids are synthetic; nothing else is altered.

availableModes.name: On request
availableModes.description: Tool calls that need approval are offered through ACP permission requests unless the independently configured native policy settles them. Applies from the next prompt.

availableModes.name: Read-only
availableModes.description: Disable workspace file writes and shell execution for the run. Applies from the next prompt.

availableModes.name: Plan
availableModes.description: Plan with workspace writes and shell execution disabled. Select another mode explicitly to implement. Applies from the next prompt.

availableModes.name: Auto-approve
availableModes.description: Automatically select host-offered approved/once choices at each stage. No persistent grants; sandbox stays enabled unless separately changed. Applies from the next prompt.

availableModes.name: Reject prompts
availableModes.description: Reject genuine pending prompts using host-offered denial choices. Known-safe tools may still run. Applies from the next prompt.
